name: Callout Kit
description: Hand-drawn annotation tools over your footage: red marker circles that draw themselves, arrows with marker labels, a magnifier box that zooms into a detail with connector lines, a pixelate blur for anything private, and a pulsing spotlight.
best_use_cases: Pointing out details in a clip
style: Hand-drawn red marker annotations over footage — self-drawing circles, arrows with labels, 2x zoom box, pixelate blur, spotlight
